sharedRules.name: Signal Relay
sharedRules.description:
Any Commander in the Asterian Force with the Communications rule can relay their Orders through a Narsa Drone, measuring the 12" radius from the Narsa rather than their own location.
In addition, they will have access to additional Orders.

sharedRules.name: Imperious
sharedRules.description: A Commander with this weapon may re-roll one command dice during the game

sharedRules.name: Power Up
sharedRules.description: A model with this special rule increases the value of his (or his unit's) shield by 1 (to a maximum of 4). Note that they must already have a shield for this to have any effect.

sharedRules.name: Observer
sharedRules.description: An Overseer within 12" of a Shuuvatar may re-roll up to one Command die per turn. However, should the Overseer fail to give an Order at any point, whether within 12" of the Shuuvatar or not, the Asterian force will suffer a penalty of – 1VP at the end of the game.

sharedRules.name: Dirge of Death Order
sharedRules.description: As a Level 2 Command the unit may re-roll all failed rolls to wound until the end of the Turn.
